        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long a = -1;
        long b = 0;
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long j = (i * x) / y;
            if ((i * x) - (j * y) > ((j + 1) * y) - (i * x))
                j++;
            if (a == -1 || Math.abs(a * y - x * b) * i > Math.abs(j * y - x * i) * b) {
                a = j;
                b = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
